text: Picture a shop where the owner, the accountant and the support desk share one portal login.

text: The support agent sends a refund to a friend, and the record says only that the shop did it.

text: In a real shop, the owner, the accountant and the cashier each have their own badge.

text: Each badge opens only the doors that job needs.
prefix: Each badge opens only the doors that job needs.

text: A merchant's team works the same way.
prefix: A merchant's team works the same way.

text: Here is how it works.
prefix: Here is how it works.

text: Each person has their own login and exactly one of four merchant roles.
prefix: Each person has their own login and exactly one of four merchant roles.

text: The admin can do everything, including the team and the settings.
prefix: The admin can do everything, including the team and the settings.

text: The accountant views and exports, and handles disputes.
prefix: The accountant views and exports, and handles disputes.

text: The operator views, exports, makes payment links, gives refunds and handles disputes.
prefix: The operator views, exports, makes payment links, gives refunds and handles disputes.

text: The observer only views.
prefix: The observer only views.

text: An admin invites people by email.
prefix: An admin invites people by email.

text: Nobody ever types another person's password.
prefix: Nobody ever types another person's password.

text: Each person sets their own password, and an authenticator app on their phone, because some of these people can give money back.
prefix: Each person sets their own password, and an authenticator app on their phone, because some of these people can give money back.

text: Every action in the portal names the roles that may run it, and nothing more.
prefix: Every action in the portal names the roles that may run it, and nothing more.

text: That is least privilege: each person gets only what their job needs.
prefix: That is least privilege: each person gets only what their job needs.

text: Changing someone's role takes effect at once, and they are signed out.
prefix: Changing someone's role takes effect at once, and they are signed out.

text: Blocking someone signs them out at once too.
prefix: Blocking someone signs them out at once too.

text: Their past actions stay in the history.
prefix: Their past actions stay in the history.

text: And a merchant can never lose its last admin.
prefix: And a merchant can never lose its last admin.

text: The last admin cannot step down or be blocked until a new admin is named.
prefix: The last admin cannot step down or be blocked until a new admin is named.

text: So nobody is ever locked out of their own shop.
prefix: So nobody is ever locked out of their own shop.

text: What does this protect?
prefix: What does this protect?

text: A shared login hides who did what.
prefix: A shared login hides who did what.

text: With a badge each, every refund and every export names a real person.

prefix: Least privilege means a stolen operator login cannot add new users or change settings.
